t: Positano, Italy: All You Must Know Before You Go (2026) - Tripadvisor
s: Considered the jewel of southern Italy's Amalfi Coast, Positano's picturesque layout is nothing short of iconic: You'll know it by its miles of colorful buildings perched on cliffs overlooking the Mediterranean (or the striped umbrellas spanning the shoreline—take your pick). Once a vital part of a mighty sea power, Positano is a sophisticated resort town today, overflowing with old-world charm and impossibly beautiful views—including the famous dome of the Chiesa di Santa Maria Assunta church.
